scope: Local native published sh/jq composition and spawn self-DUP2 correctness; no deployment or publication.

baseline.nativeRegression: The child fixture marks fd 9 CLOEXEC and appends spawn DUP2(9,9). Before the fix, the child loses fd 9; the native spawn/wait test returns result 6 instead of 0.
baseline.systemOracle: Native C posix_spawn_file_actions_adddup2(fd,fd) with an O_CLOEXEC descriptor: child_exit=0 parent_cloexec=1.

implementation: A successful spawn DUP2 action clears CLOEXEC in the staged child table even when source and target are equal. Direct fd_dup2 self-duplication retains its prior behavior. No budget change or package-specific interception.

validation.focused: 10 native tests across 3 files, 145 assertions, 18.05 seconds.
validation.fullCheck: bun run check passed: build, SDK declarations, typecheck, workspace Clippy and Cargo, 338 native tests across 57 files, 4366 assertions, 124.70 seconds.
validation.format: bun run format:check and git diff --check passed.
composition: Published sh pipeline into published jq returns 42.
Line-oriented shell pipeline retains both lines.
Child stdout/stderr redirected into one regular file preserve outerr, read by a later jq invocation.
Existing child exits, traps, shared inode/offset, CLOEXEC, closefrom and parent table isolation remain covered.
Same-build umask heap handover across Queue and Worker replacement remains covered.

archiveBinding.transport: native Alchemy workerd service binding and Agent RPC; local R2 and Queue
archiveBinding.proof: SDK archive exports and consumer declarations; runtime archive; filesystem snapshot restore; hard-link metadata; RPC callbacks and cooperative disposal; persistent driver contexts and cancellation; scoped authority

minuteiConsumer.transport: native workerd Agent service binding; actual Minutei Code Mode and tenant SQLite; local R2, KV and Queue

openFindings.hostBoundary: The pinned published sh emits an empty spawn action list for this redirect. Builtin printf >&2 works and regular-file redirection sends real DUP2 actions. No inferred host remapping was introduced.

openFindings.observed: WASI host request budget exceeded; no terminal output acknowledged.
openFindings.boundary: The existing process-family 256 host-request ceiling is shared across children. The write and read work as separately bounded executions. The ceiling is unchanged.

limits: No deployment, remote binding/model proof, publication or GitHub operation.
8 MiB is guest linear-memory admission, not measured total Worker or peak memory.
No performance, cold-start, scale or AgentOS cost advantage established.
Default software bundle, complete shell conformance, PTY and remaining parity gates stay open.
Minutei proof covers the selected SDK 0.9.0 fixtures only; its history Queue has no consumer and authenticated/model/browser paths were not exercised.
